properties.name: text
properties.description: Alternative for default slot/children. Do not use together with a text children/slot, as both will be rendered and result in duplicate labels.

design.name: ✏️ Path
design.note: Figma carries one text property per variant: ✏️ Root (default `Home`), ✏️ Path (default `Path`) and ✏️ Current (default `Current`). In code it is a single `text` prop for every role.

design.name: 🔀 Variant
design.note: Figma-only. In code the role follows from the position and from `ariaCurrent`: the first item is the root, `ariaCurrent` marks the current page, and the truncation is produced by `maxItems` on the breadcrumb or by the Breadcrumb Popover Item.

properties.name: ariaCurrent
properties.description: Marks the item as the current page/step, forwarded as `aria-current` to the rendered link or text. The last item of a trail should use `page`.

design.note: Figma models the current page as the variant value `Current` instead of a dedicated property. Without an explicit value the breadcrumb defaults the last item of the trail to `page`.

properties.name: icon
properties.description: Define an icon by its identifier (like e.g. _user_, compare to [Icons](https://design-system.deutschebahn.com/core-web/review/main/foundations/icons/overview)) to get displayed in front of the elements content.

properties.name: showIcon
properties.description: Enables or disables the visibility of the icon. The default value depends on the component. For many components this property is optional to reflect Figma properties.

properties.name: iconLeading
properties.description: Define an icon by its identifier (like e.g. _user_, compare to [Icons](https://design-system.deutschebahn.com/core-web/review/main/foundations/icons/overview)) to get displayed in front of the elements content.

properties.name: showIconLeading
properties.description: Enables or disables the visibility of the leading icon. For many components this property is optional to reflect Figma properties.

properties.name: noText
properties.description: Define the text next to the icon specified via the icon Property to get hidden.

design.name: 🔄 Separator
design.note: Figma swaps the separator per item (🛟 Breadcrumb Separator, Chevron Right or Slash, each in a Small and a Medium variant). In code there is no item-level property; `separator` is set once on the breadcrumb and applies to the whole trail.

No variant property in Figma. Small and Medium are modelled as separate component sets (↳ Breadcrumb Item → (Def) Small and → Medium). In code the item inherits the size from the breadcrumb, which writes it as data-size.

design.name: 🔀 Interaction State
design.note: Figma-only. Documents the visual states of the item; in code these are the native interaction states of the underlying anchor and are not a property.

design.name: 📦 Children
design.note: In code the composition API places the anchor in the default slot; the tooltip label is then read from the slotted anchor.

properties.name: target
properties.description: Where to open the linked URL, as the name for a [browsing context](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/a#target).

properties.name: rel
properties.description: The relationship of the linked URL as space-separated link types.
